name: R6 Dynamic Ragdoll
desc:
Enjoy an open sandbox experience with advanced ragdoll physics. Get hit by hammers, jump down mountains, fling other players, run over NPC's with your car & so much more!

Game starts with automatic ragdolling, change in settings if you want.

🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE - Night sky, Halloween Decorations, Trick or Treat available at the house, Pumpkin Launcher, Hallow Slap Tool, Bug Fixes.
To turn off the night sky that is enabled automatically, go to the top of your screen and tap the sun icon.

PRESS "R" TO RAGDOLL ON PC

💣Level Rewards
♨️Bouncy Springs
🛝Slides
🖐️Slap & Fling Tools

⭐ Follow @pixlyze on Roblox! (go to my profile, click the 3 dots and press follow.)

Do note, this is in beta testing, There might be some bugs!
